facts.fact: Biometric Update reports the World Bank and the ID4D project revised the project in 2024 partly to upgrade the national identity management system to enable authentication services, with an $83 million integrator tender for NIMS 2.0 open until 3 February 2025.

NGA.note: Nothing on a link between civil registration and the ID system.
Only a planned NIMC data-centre upgrade; nothing on a data centre for hire.
Only that coverage targets were missed; no count or share given.
Nothing on a number at birth.
The integrator is to support and maintain NIMS 2.0 under a 2-year contract; no statement on national operation or ownership.
Nothing on other registers keyed on the NIN.

facts.fact: Nigeria's ID4D Project Implementation Unit is tendering an $83 million contract, financed by the World Bank with EU support, for a system integrator to design, supply, commission and maintain NIMS 2.0 with the MOSIP platform and an upgraded biometric identification system.

NGA.note: Only a headline link in related posts; no other system checking against the ID is stated in the article.
Only a planned upgrade of NIMC data centres; no data centre for hire stated.
The biometric system is to be implemented in a secondary data centre for disaster recovery, with no place named and not in service.
